thread:
maria: Heads up — planning to open release/1.13 on Tue 03:00 UTC. Version bump + changelog window closes 24h before the cut.

maria: If you need backports/cherry-picks, drop PR links + short reason (critical/regression/docs). We will not accept feature backports without eng-lead signoff.

junaid: policy recap — backports allowed for: critical bugfix, regression, security fixes, and docs. Feature requests -> post-release. Add label `backport/urgent` for priority.

evan: I have a telemetry fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5421
evan: low-risk but touches runtime path. Tests green on main. Would like this in release branch.

maria: @evan please add a one-line risk note + test plan in PR. Also mark whether it needs a manual cherry-pick or can use the script.

evan: done — added test plan and marked "manual": short regression test and smoketest steps.

maria: @eng-sre (alex) can you sanity-check runtime touch and schedule canary if approved?

alex: Canary scheduled Wed 06:00 UTC for PR #5421. Will run telemetry smoke and perf baseline.

junaid: Approving backport for #5421 on the condition canary looks good. Add label `cherry-pick-request`.

release-bot: Reminder: release branch creation window opens Tue 03:00 UTC. Changelog freeze 24h prior. See https://go/release-process for details.

tara: Helm charts also need version bump (charts/redwood-core). Do we include chart bump in the branch or post-release?

olivia: prefer in-branch to keep artifacts reproducible. I'll open a PR against release/1.13 once branch exists.

jun: Changelog format reminder — one-line entries like: `component: short description (#PR)`; small prose OK but please keep to single sentence. I can collate entries if you ping me.

maria: Quick how-to for cherry-picks (put in thread so folks can copy):
```
# run from repo root
./dev/release/cherry_pick.sh 5421 release/1.13
# or manual
git fetch origin
git checkout -b cherry/5421 release/1.13
git cherry-pick <commit>
```

maria: Checklist for branch cut :
- open release/1.13 at Tue 03:00 UTC
- post changelog PRs by Mon 23:59 UTC
- freeze non-critical merges 24h before cut
- collect backports with labels and PR links
- run canaries for runtime touches

tara: I'll send a reminder Mon 18:00 UTC for changelog finalization.

evan: thanks all — pinging here when canary finishes. :thumbsup:

maria: Perfect. If anything else pops up, drop it here. Thanks! :rocket:
